---
name: Hardware or recovery report
about: Share sanitized, reproducible results
---

## Hardware and storage family
Motherboard, CPU, controller/NIC PCI IDs, QTS or QuTS hero, RAID/Qtier layout (no serials).

## Exact versions and provenance
Firmware/build, loader source/hash, boot mode.

## Validation gates
VM initialization/update/cold boot; physical HAL scan AND reverse lookup; pool/tier/volume state; file baseline comparison; unattended boot.

## Failure or result
Include redacted output. Do not attach firmware, disk images, credentials or raw inventory reports.

## Unverified items
